:::{#exr-rss-ols-fit}
#### Residual sum of squares of the OLS fit

Assuming $\sspred > 0$ (@def-centered-sums),
write the [residual sum of squares](#def-rss)
at the OLS estimates (@thm-ols-slr),
$\text{RSS}(\hintcoef, \hcoef{x}) = \sumin \resid_\iobs^2$,
in terms of $\sspred$, $\ssout$ and $\sspredout$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-ols-fit}

The [fitted values](prediction.qmd#def-fitted-value)
of the OLS fit are $\fitted_\iobs = \hintcoef + \hcoef{x} \predvar_\iobs$,
so each [residual](prediction.qmd#def-residual) is

$$
\begin{aligned}
\resid_\iobs
&= \outvar_\iobs - \fitted_\iobs
&& \text{(definition of a residual)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \paren{\hintcoef + \hcoef{x} \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(substitute $\fitted_\iobs$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \paren{\outbar - \hcoef{x} \predbar + \hcoef{x} \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(substitute $\hintcoef$)}\\
&= \outvar_\iobs - \outbar + \hcoef{x} \predbar - \hcoef{x} \predvar_\iobs
&& \text{(distribute the minus sign)}\\
&= (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar) - \paren{\hcoef{x} \predvar_\iobs - \hcoef{x} \predbar}
&& \text{(group terms)}\\
&= (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar) - \hcoef{x} (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)
&& \text{(factor out $\hcoef{x}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

Squaring and summing:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\sumin \resid_\iobs^2
&= \sumin \paren{(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar) - \hcoef{x} (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)}^2
&& \text{(substitute $\resid_\iobs$)}\\
&= \sumin \paren{(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
  + \hcoef{x}^2 (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2}
&& \text{(expand the square)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)^2 - \sumin 2 \hcoef{x} (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
  + \sumin \hcoef{x}^2 (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(sum of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
  + \sumin \hcoef{x}^2 (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)^2 - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
  + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \hcoef{x} \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)(\outvar_\iobs - \outbar)
  + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(definition of $\ssout$)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \hcoef{x} \sspredout + \hcoef{x}^2 \sumin (\predvar_\iobs - \predbar)^2
&& \text{(definition of $\sspredout$)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \hcoef{x} \sspredout + \hcoef{x}^2 \sspred
&& \text{(definition of $\sspred$)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \frac{\sspredout}{\sspred} \sspredout + \paren{\frac{\sspredout}{\sspred}}^2 \sspred
&& \text{(substitute $\hcoef{x} = \sspredout / \sspred$)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred} + \paren{\frac{\sspredout}{\sspred}}^2 \sspred
&& \text{(multiply)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred} + \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred^2} \sspred
&& \text{(square of a quotient)}\\
&= \ssout - 2 \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred} + \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred}
&& \text{(cancel one factor of $\sspred$)}\\
&= \ssout - \frac{\sspredout^2}{\sspred}
&& \text{(combine like terms)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
